sql_calls.sql: SELECT * FROM store.forecasts WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' ORDER BY date;

SELECT date(bill_ts) d, sku_scanned, count(*) lines, sum(qty) units, count(DISTINCT bill_id) bills
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-10' AND bill_ts < '2026-06-29'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT 'stock_count' src, count_ts::text ts, sku, book_before::text a, counted::text b, adjustment::text c, trigger::text d
FROM store.stock_counts WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_off', date::text, sku, units::text, reason, '', ''
FROM store.write_offs WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'goods_receipt', received_ts::text, sku_booked, units_booked::text, asn_units::text, grn_id, shipment_id
FROM store.goods_receipts WHERE sku_booked='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT a.audit_ts, a.sku, a.status, ds.units_sold, ds.revenue_inr, ib.book_on_hand_close
FROM store.shelf_audits a
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON ds.sku=a.sku AND ds.date=a.audit_ts::date
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book ib ON ib.sku=a.sku AND ib.date=a.audit_ts::date
ORDER BY a.sku, a.audit_ts;

SELECT date(bill_ts) d, sku_scanned, count(*) lines, sum(qty) units, count(DISTINCT bill_id) bills
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-23' AND bill_ts < '2026-06-29' AND sku_scanned LIKE 'ATTA%'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT date(bill_ts) d,
       count(DISTINCT bill_id) bills,
       count(*) lines,
       sum(qty) units,
       sum(CASE WHEN sku_scanned LIKE 'ATTA%' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) atta_units
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-06-29'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
